description: The N1QL Feature Controller setting has a different name on each of the four surfaces that can change it, as set out in query-without-index.md's own Table 1: 'N1QL Feature Controller' (Couchbase Web Console), `--n1ql-feature-control` (CLI, couchbase-cli setting-query), `queryN1QLFeatCtrl` (cluster-level Query Settings REST API), and `n1ql-feat-ctrl` (node-level Query Admin REST API). Four surfaces, four spellings, with the CLI using 'control' where the UI uses 'Controller' and the two REST APIs disagreeing with each other.
note:
Filed because of what the setting IS rather than for tidiness: it is a bitmask whose bits control unrelated query features, so a reader who guesses the wrong option name on the wrong surface does not get an error - they get a different setting, or a silently cleared set of bits. See docs-issues/server-sequential-scan-switch-on-procedure-uses-xor, which is the same setting documented with the wrong operation. The two defects compound: the procedure is wrong AND the thing it operates on is named differently everywhere.
Credit where due: Table 1 is a good piece of documentation - it exists precisely to map the four names, and it is how this was found. The defect is upstream of the page, in the product's naming.
